items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (calf) officially active vs Raiders after optimistic reports and feeling better Saturday.
items.why: No setbacks; team optimistic as long as no issues. Did not practice Fri but improved Sat.
items.implication: Start with confidence; primary target opposite Adams OUT.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; elite WR1 upside vs LV.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room (thigh) then returned; questionable to return earlier per Rapoport.
items.why: In-game thigh issue; cleared to return.
items.implication: Monitor snap count rest of game; usage intact if limited only briefly.
items.opportunity: Continued dual-threat with WR outs; slot looks possible.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) officially inactive after unlikely-to-play reports; limited practice, not full participant.
items.why: Sources: bit early after missing three; may workout but unlikely.
items.implication: Handcuff/lead back elevates fully vs MIA.
items.opportunity: Full carries/snaps for backup RB; strong matchup.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) ruled out vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley to start again. Close call but misses third straight.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday; limited practice but not ready.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and dual-threat floor drop. Flowers/Henry usage shifts possible.
items.opportunity: Backup QB volume; Zay Flowers target share stable or up in pass-heavy script.

items.text: Broncos CB Pat Surtain II (ankle) officially inactive; unlikely earlier, good chance back next week.
items.implication: DEN secondary weaker; opposing WR upgrade (e.g. vs ARI).
items.opportunity: Matchup boost for Cardinals pass catchers.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated from exempt list and expected to play Sunday.
items.why: Activated Saturday; set for return post-layoff.
items.implication: Workload question after absence; monitor snaps vs DET.
items.opportunity: Potential lead carries if full go; handcuff reverse.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: AJ Brown and Goedert target share surge; Hurts pass game concentrated.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for remaining pass-catchers; red-zone to TE/RB.

items.text: 49ers activated WR Christian Kirk for debut amid Evans/Deebo OUT.
items.implication: Significant WR role with room depleted; CMC slot temptation.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes expansion for Kirk and CMC.

items.text: Vikings RB Jordan Mason activated off IR; expected to play vs Colts.
items.implication: Run game boost; committee or lead potential.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) questionable but expected to play Monday vs Cowboys; DeVonta Smith OUT.
items.why: Official report and sources indicate return likely after recovery.
items.implication: Start if active; lead back role resumes.
items.opportunity: Carries, red-zone, dual-threat volume if cleared.

items.text: Texans WR Tank Dell activated to active roster; set for first NFL action in nearly two years Sunday.
items.implication: Immediate role possible in HOU WR corps; monitor targets.

items.text: Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; by end of year the Broncos RB you wish you had. Activated from IR.
Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial for DFS slate; sneaky scratches include Egbuka, Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Jahwar Jordan. Projections updated to latest news.
items.why: Core for main slate; missed scratches impact depth charts.
items.implication: Pivot on OUT/INACTIVE; Bijan full workload if BRob out.

items.text: Tempted to buy CMC lining up more at slot amid 49ers WR injuries (Evans/Deebo OUT, Kirk debut) despite usual skepticism of RB-as-WR claims; Kaelon Black presence noted.
items.why: Dire WR situation + CMC smile comment; rare buy-in.
items.implication: Potential route/target boost beyond RB work; DFS/flex appeal.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps in slot, two-minute, third-down.
items.conflict: Historical low conversion of such statements.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown usage/matchup (WR10) vs CHI; volume and Bears D allow yardage.
items.why: Usage + favorable matchup; Bears good for WR yardage.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; elevated with Smith OUT.
items.opportunity: Targets, air yards vs soft D.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft (TE buffet) vs DET; Lions allow high TE production (9 TDs in 5 games).
Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow by Gonzalez); 90% outside targets, low floor history.
items.why: Tough CB shadow; limited production profile.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs post-layoff (RB18) vs DET; workload questions after absence.
items.conflict: Activation/expected play signals positive volume possible.
